Definition: from G2228 and G5104; either indeed:--whether.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, ḗtoi means either indeed. It occurs just once, in Romans.
TheologicalSignificance: I take ḗtoi as it stands — either indeed — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
